steps.action_code:
recommendation_page_limit = 20
recommendation_page_index = 0
recommendation_pages = []
all_recommendations = []
recommendations_exhausted = False
while True:
    recommendation_page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(
        access_token=spotify_access_token,
        page_index=recommendation_page_index,
        page_limit=recommendation_page_limit,
    )
    recommendation_pages.append(recommendation_page)
    all_recommendations.extend(recommendation_page)
    if len(recommendation_page) < recommendation_page_limit:
        recommendations_exhausted = True
        break
    recommendation_page_index += 1
recommended_song_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(record["song_id"] for record in all_recommendations))
print({"recommendation_records_read": len(all_recommendations), "unique_recommended_songs": len(recommended_song_ids), "pages_read": len(recommendation_pages)})
